module_title: Lakes and Waterfalls - Formation Types and Key Locations
introduction: At this level, we classify lakes based on their geological formation (craters, lagoons, ox-bows) and locate visually and geographically significant waterfalls across different states.

core_concepts.title: Lonar Lake (Maharashtra)
core_concepts.description: A highly unique 'Crater Lake' located in the Buldhana district. It was formed by a meteorite impact during the Pleistocene Epoch. Its water is both saline and alkaline.

core_concepts.title: Pulicat Lake (Andhra Pradesh / Tamil Nadu)
core_concepts.description: The second largest brackish water lagoon in India. It is separated from the Bay of Bengal by the barrier island of Sriharikota (where ISRO's space center is located).

core_concepts.title: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
core_concepts.description: Meaning 'Sea of Milk', this stunning four-tiered waterfall is located on the 'Mandovi River' right on the border of Goa and Karnataka.

core_concepts.title: Sivasamudram Falls
core_concepts.description: Located on the 'Cauvery River' in Karnataka. It is historically significant because Asia's first hydro-electric power station was set up here in 1902.

core_concepts.title: Hundru Falls
core_concepts.description: A famous waterfall located on the 'Subarnarekha River' near Ranchi, Jharkhand, formed where the river falls from the edge of the Chotanagpur Plateau.

important_entities.name: Ox-bow Lakes
important_entities.significance: When a river bends sharply and eventually cuts off a U-shaped body of water, it forms an ox-bow lake. 'Kanwar Lake' in Bihar (formed by the Gandak river) is Asia's largest freshwater ox-bow lake.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: If asked for the location of Pulicat Lake, note that roughly 96% of it is in Andhra Pradesh and only 4% is in Tamil Nadu. Always choose Andhra Pradesh if forced to pick one state.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Milk (Dudh) needs a Man (Mandovi) to Go (Goa)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Dudhsagar is on the Mandovi river in Goa.

exam_strategy_tips: Match the formation with the lake: Meteorite = Lonar, Tectonic = Wular, Lagoon = Chilika/Pulicat/Vembanad.
State PCS exams often ask for the river of Hundru falls (Subarnarekha) and Sivasamudram (Cauvery).
